# Svyable Desk

> Working drafts of Svyable books. Desk is a writing and revision surface; released editions live on Svyable Shelf.

This file is the low-noise machine-readable map of the Desk. Working drafts can change at any time. Do not infer publication from presence here.

## Primary entry points

- [Desk home](https://svyable.github.io/desk/) — working-draft catalog.
- [Desk Reader](https://svyable.github.io/desk/reader/) — human-facing Reader for current drafts when Desk Pages is enabled.
- [Repository overview](https://svyable.github.io/desk/README.md) — Desk/Shelf model, catalog, preview, and release workflow.
- [Agent guidance](https://svyable.github.io/desk/AGENTS.md) — repository rules for agents modifying Desk content.
- [Crawler policy](https://svyable.github.io/desk/robots.txt) — crawl policy for the public Pages surface.
- [Sitemap](https://svyable.github.io/desk/sitemap.xml) — canonical public discovery URLs.
- [Released Shelf Reader](https://svyable.github.io/shelf/reader/) — deliberately released editions.

## Reading a book

Use the book README as the canonical table of contents. Its relative links lead to the current manuscript files under `manuscript/`, plus book-specific research and media where present.

A Desk Reader route has the form:

`https://svyable.github.io/desk/reader/#/b/<slug>/`

The Reader route is a working proof, not a publication marker. Released editions are separate snapshots on Svyable Shelf.
